description.fun: Heatmor is an anteater with a tongue made of fire. It draws air in through a hole in its tail, turns it into flame, and uses that flame like a tongue to melt through the steel bodies of Durant so it can eat their insides. If the hole in its tail gets blocked, it falls ill. Its wrists and tail look like the vents and muffler of an ironworks. Ken Sugimori designed it together with its prey, Durant.
description.guide: Heatmor is a Fire-type anteater Pokémon that breathes through a hole in its tail and uses a tongue of flame to melt and eat Durant. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: An anteater with a flaming tongue that melts steel ants.
